summary: Yield replication repair writer loans after 20ms of cooperative work

replay.detail: Repair application remains idempotent and ordered; restart rechecks committed repairs before continuing.

schema.detail: No persisted format or index changes.

rules.detail: A repair and affected operation reconciliation still commit atomically. Failed repairs retain their existing health diagnostics.

compatibility.detail: Receive and wake continue applying their complete captured repair list before returning; short pages do not skip candidates.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon restart deploys this cooperative limit.

recovery.detail: Existing transaction rollback and restart semantics remain. A single repair, operation reconciliation or COMMIT can exceed the allowance; no active work is interrupted.
